messages:
Mia Chen: Quick idea — run a gamified badging pilot for SI onboarding that ties directly into the cloud marketplace listing and joint announcement playbook. low effort MVP: 3-tier badges + a 1-day hands-on lab + a short cert exam. pilot with Orbita and H-Edge. thoughts? :tada:
Devin Patel: love this. helps us standardize partner capabilities and gives customers confidence in marketplace filters. propose tiers: Verified (basic deploy/run), Advanced (custom integrations), Premier (solution co-build + perf tuning).
Jordan Lee: timeline thought — Q2 pilot: week 1 docs + lab, week 2 cohorts, week 3 cert + badges issued, week 4 feedback loop. would need materials and a scoreboard.
Sarah O'Neill: ops check — how do we issue badges? Credly seems standard. also need to confirm what data goes on the public badge (no sensitive infra details). we'll need SSO mapping to company profiles.
Akash Rao: for hardware partners (H-Edge) labs we need dedicated test nodes + hardware profiles. can we reuse our dedicated staging pool? might need quota bump.
Mia Chen: good call. Devin — can you draft the badge criteria for each tier? Jordan — can you own the lab runbook + scoreboard? Sarah — ops for badge issuance + privacy constraints. Akash — list of infra reqs by partner.
Devin Patel: will draft. quick sketch: Verified = pass checklist (deploy sample model, run 1k tokens/min), Advanced = integration scenario (webhook + KV cache), Premier = performance tuning + rollback drills.
Jordan Lee: working on runbook. provisional lab commands (mini):
```bash
# spin up demo stack
redwoodctl deploy --stack si-lab --model redwood-small --region us-west1
# run perf harness
perf-harness run --concurrency 8 --seq 512 --duration 300s
```
I'll add exact metrics to the doc.
Sarah O'Neill: Credly is fine — we'll need an internal approval flow before issuance. also add a revoke policy for badging if partner breaks SLA.
marketplace-bot: Draft playbook uploaded: https://docs.redwood.com/partners/si-badging-pilot (internal).
Mia Chen: perfect. one extra ask — coordinate a soft joint announcement with marketing for pilot launch (no partner logos until we have approvals). Marketing link: /marketing/partner-announce-template.
Akash Rao: I'll enumerate H-Edge node types + estimated cost. need someone from finance to approve credits for pilot winners.
Devin Patel: will include a short MCQ (10 q) + practical step in the cert. pass = 80%. badges auto-issued after manual verification step.
Jordan Lee: action items summary: Devin (badge criteria + exam), Jordan (lab runbook + scoreboard), Sarah (Credly setup + policy), Akash (infra reqs + cost), Mia (pilot partner coord + announcement). target dates: draft by EOD Friday; pilot kickoff in 2 weeks.
Mia Chen: thanks all — if anyone wants to be in the sandbox cohort ping me. cc @Jordan @Devin @Sarah @Akash :rocket:
Devin Patel: pinged marketing for announcement sync.
Sarah O'Neill: added privacy checklist to the doc.
Akash Rao: requested extra staging quota with infra-reqs ticket #9872.
Mia Chen: awesome. we'll reconvene next Wed for final signoff. :white_check_mark:
